reconcile.note: Henry reads Matthew's justified as evidential vindication of a changed heart at judgment, not the forensic acquittal Psalm 143 denies to all.

sides.snippet: Don't enter into judgment with your servant, For in your sight no man living is righteous.
sides.verseText: Don't enter into judgment with your servant, For in your sight no man living is righteous.

sides.snippet: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.
sides.verseText: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.\"
